title: Repetitive Element Annotation Protocol for the Eastern Banjo Frog
author: Qiye Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc4niyve

steps.title: Perform Homology-Based Repetitive Element Identification
steps.instruction: Identify known repetitive elements in the Limnodynastes dumerilii dumerilii genome assembly using homology-based predictions.

substeps.instruction: Align genome sequences against Repbase-derived RepeatMasker libraries using RepeatMasker (v4.1.0) with parameters '-nolow -norna -no is'.
Align genome sequences against the transposable element protein database using RepeatProteinMask (RepeatMasker package) with parameters '-noLowSimple -pvalue 0.0001 -engine ncbi'.

steps.title: Perform De Novo Repetitive Element Identification
steps.instruction: Identify repetitive elements in the Limnodynastes dumerilii dumerilii genome assembly using de novo predictions.

substeps.instruction: Run RepeatModeler (v2.0, RRID:SCR_015027) on the assembly to build a species-specific de novo repeat library.
Align genome sequences against the generated de novo library using RepeatMasker (v4.1.0).

steps.title: Identify Tandem Repeats
steps.instruction: Identify tandem repeats in the Limnodynastes dumerilii dumerilii genome assembly using Tandem Repeats Finder (v4.09).

substeps.instruction: Run Tandem Repeats Finder with parameters 'Match=2 Mismatch=7 Delta=7 PM=80 PI=10 Minscore=50 MaxPeriod=2000'.
